Adaptive Figure Height for a Subgroup-Distribution Plot

Source: R/plot_sg_distribution.R
sgdist_fig_height.Rd

Computes a reasonable knitr fig.height (in inches) for a plot_sg_distribution() panel based on the number of bars, keeping the visual quality consistent across scenarios with very different numbers of distinct subgroup labels.

Usage

sgdist_fig_height(
  n_bars,
  floor_in = 4,
  ceil_in = 10,
  per_bar = 0.35,
  base_in = 3
)

Arguments

n_bars

Integer. Number of bars in the plot, typically retrieved via attr(p, "n_bars") on a plot returned by plot_sg_distribution().

floor_in

Numeric. Minimum height in inches. Default: 4.0.

ceil_in

Numeric. Maximum height in inches. Default: 10.0.

per_bar

Numeric. Height contribution per bar in inches. Default: 0.35.

base_in

Numeric. Base height added to per_bar * n_bars before applying the floor / ceiling. Default: 3.0.

Value

Numeric scalar, a height in inches in [floor_in, ceil_in]. Suitable for the fig.height chunk option.

See also

plot_sg_distribution

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
p <- plot_sg_distribution(results, placeholder_on_empty = TRUE)
h <- sgdist_fig_height(attr(p, "n_bars"))
# Use `h` as the fig.height chunk option.
} # }
